description: Shell capability. Local bundled pages (the boot screen) get core window/event access. The app itself is served from a loopback origin, and Tauri denies IPC to remote origins unless they are listed under `remote.urls` — without that, window.__TAURI__ is absent in the app and the notification shim silently never installs. Tauri's URL patterns cannot wildcard the PORT, so the canonical port is listed explicitly; the shell warns at startup when BE_DESKTOP_PORT overrides it, because notifications would silently stop working there.
